scientific_question: In actor_only training with the mission-slack input, do immediate-FD transitions encourage a larger SEVERE-minus-MILD ABORT contrast; do other transitions counteract that direction; and how does the REAL clipped-gradient Adam step change the contrast on the SAME observations?
nature: an instrumented diagnostic, not a proposed policy improvement; observation, topology, masks, action semantics, rewards, returns, advantage normalization, loss reduction, optimizer, hyperparameters, population and FD mechanics unchanged; no critic constructed or trained

prefix_comparison.implementation: scripts/compare_prefix.py (declared here, before launch; self-checked on the original by scripts/check_compare_prefix.py)
prefix_comparison.fields_compared: episode outcomes (seeds, realized worlds, construction, FD plan / certificate, rewards, every wake's inputs, probabilities, scores and selected action), failures (stage, error class, message), credit rows (stored log-probs, actions, rewards, returns, advantages), train records, eval records; checkpoints 24 / 49 / 74 / 99 in the final report
prefix_comparison.excluded: wall-clock timing keys, filesystem paths and tracebacks, run-random UUID identities (generated ids are not seed-stable); the new diagnostic stream
prefix_comparison.first_divergence: the earliest record, in the new run's own order, with any normalized difference; reported with its location, the differing field and its magnitude
prefix_comparison.classification: policy_side = at the first differing wake every recorded actor input and every earlier wake is identical but a policy output differs (or a credit row's stored log-prob / action differs); input_side = any other first difference (world, construction, tick, wake kind, actor input, episode physics)
prefix_comparison.stop_rule: a policy_side first divergence is a MATERIAL UNEXPLAINED DISCREPANCY (different actor outputs from identical inputs = different parameters, which the observational diagnostic must never cause): the launcher kills the run and preserves partial evidence. An input_side first divergence is the pre-declared known class (BLADE run-to-run execution nondeterminism, measurements section 16.3): it is reported and the run continues; later records are compared only descriptively
prefix_comparison.monitoring: the launcher runs the comparison at every 120-second heartbeat
prefix_comparison.no_adaptation: neither the normalization, the tolerance nor the rule is changed after launch

primary_diagnostic.statistic: per productive update holding both FD severities: full-update actual delta C_B = C_B(theta after epoch 3) - C_B(theta before epoch 0) on that batch's stored immediate-FD rows (update_summary.full_update_delta), with the four epoch deltas
primary_diagnostic.explanatory_fields: per epoch: raw gradient-descent pressures -dot(h, g) of each group, combined FD, combined non-FD, entropy component and total; h norm and alignments; actual pre / post-clip gradient norms; dot(h, delta_theta) (first-order prediction for the actual Adam displacement); actual delta C_B and the linearization residual
primary_diagnostic.coverage: EVERY update reported; undefined updates (a severity absent) counted with their reason; no batch rebalancing
primary_diagnostic.window_summaries: eligible and undefined counts; mean, q10, median, q90 and mean absolute value; positive / negative / numerically-negligible counts
primary_diagnostic.numerically_negligible_reporting_scale: |value| < 1e-6 is reported as numerically negligible (a reporting scale, not a success threshold)
primary_diagnostic.no_success_threshold: no success threshold is defined by a positive sign alone; changing-batch contrasts are never summed as one policy-quality curve
primary_diagnostic.contrast_scope: C_B compares training populations inside one batch; it is not the benchmark's matched-world macro endpoint

secondary_behaviour.statistic: the existing ten-base-cell macro P(ABORT | SEVERE) - P(ABORT | MILD), directional and reverse switches and the separate probabilities
secondary_behaviour.rounds: all five matched development rounds (0, 25, 50, 75, 100); final endpoint at update 100
secondary_behaviour.comparison: only against the corresponding rounds of the original run
secondary_behaviour.also: group / cell denominators, reward / utility / survival outcomes, full attempt accounting
secondary_behaviour.expectation: near-identical behaviour is expected from a pure observer and is not a failure

interpretation_limits: FD surrogate pressure, opposing / aligned non-FD or entropy pressure, actual Adam movement, nonlinear discrepancy and near-zero sensitivity are distinguished
the measurements can prioritize a future intervention; they do not prove a sole cause or a defective critic
negative advantages and cross-episode ABORT-vs-PLAN reward means are not causal action values
one seed, development only, repeated frozen worlds; no generalization or robustness claim
too few batches with both severities is reported as limited coverage, not as permission to extend or rebalance
